 Mr. Rishu Mahajan, Advocate
 for the petitioner.

Mr. Amit Rana, Sr. Dag, Punjab
 for respondent No.1-State.

** **
Manjari Nehru Kaul, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioner is seeking quashing of Fir No.130 dated 23.05.2019 under Sections 170, 420,
120-B, 467, 468 and 471 of the Ipc and Section 65 and 66-D of the It Act, 2005 registered at Police
Station Sadar, Amritsar (Annexure P-1) on the basis of compromise stated to have been effected
with the complainant dated 08.10.2021 (Annexure P-2).
2.
Mr. Pankaj Khurana, Advocate for Mr. Vinod K. Kaushal, Advocate has put in an appearance and filed power of attorney on behalf of respondent No.2 which is taken on record.
He has strongly disputed the submissions made by the counsel opposite qua the parties having effected a compromise.

He submits that since the petitioner has failed to adhere to the terms and conditions of the compromise which were decided between them, he would oppose the prayer for quashing of the FIR in question.
